''See also: [[Grace Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Grace is a character who possesses purple eyes and engages in combat using a [[sword]]. During battle, she is supported by her cousins, Akura Courage{{!}}Courage and Akura Douji{{!}}Douji, as well as [[Naru Saeya]]. In social or political contexts, she is viewed by others as someone who evaluates potential partners based on their suitability for her family's approval and her own personal compatibility. She has been involved in discussions regarding future alliances, with some suggesting she is a person of growing importance. Additionally, Grace has encountered individuals capable of using illusions to disguise their true identities, such as a young woman from the [[Truegold]] lineage who used magic to appear masculine.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A [[Truegold]] hailing from an unremarkable clan, Grace possesses a [[void key]] and is the cousin of both Akura Courage{{!}}Courage and Akura Douji{{!}}Douji. While finishing her training as an acolyte, she utilizes a long, curved [[steel]] [[sword]] retrieved from her [[soulspace]]. Although she has performed well in combat as a member of [[Lindon]]'s team, her [[sacred instrument]] has begun to weaken and occasionally suffers from activation delays. Despite her combat prowess, she bears a cloth wrap over a missing eye.}}
